files.reason: `fanout herdr` is a user-facing subcommand: the runtime name is the command word operators type, so the FILE NAME spells it. This entry covers the file name finding only; every identifier inside the file is registered individually with a file scope, so new runtime-named code cannot ride in on this entry.

identifiers.name: Tmux
identifiers.reason: backend.Tmux is a persisted runtime name read back as data (state rows, PaneRef). Branching on it for lane selection is what MutationModel and the capabilities replaced; reading it is not. Scoped to the reviewed data-read sites: a new file spelling it must be added here, which is the review gate against a new name-based branch.
